name: Sea Sonic Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in Taipei, Taiwan, in 1975, Sea Sonic Electronics Co., Ltd. is primarily engaged in the design, production, and sale of power conversion products. Operating from its Taiwanese base, the firm specializes in manufacturing a variety of power supplies for both consumer and industrial applications, marketed under its Seasonic brand. These offerings are also widely exported to global destinations, including the United States and Europe.
